[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Ansible Control Flow: Conditionals (when) and Loops (loop, with_items)"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"In Ansible, control flow structures allow you to dynamically alter playbook execution based on system facts, registered variables, or by iterating over lists of data. This tutorial covers the modern 'when' conditional and both 'loop' and 'with_items' looping constructs."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Conditional Execution with the 'when' Statement"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"The 'when' clause is used to conditionally execute a task. It accepts a raw Jinja2 expression without the double curly braces {{ }}. Ansible evaluates this expression against host facts or variables before running the task."},{"order":5,"type":"code","text":"--- 
- name: Install Apache on Ubuntu
  hosts: webservers
  tasks:
    - name: Install Apache2 on Debian/Ubuntu
      apt:
        name: apache2
        state: present
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian""},{"order":6,"type":"subheading","text":"Combining Multiple Conditions"},{"order":7,"type":"paragraph","text":"You can combine multiple conditions using lists (which act as a logical AND) or standard boolean operators like 'and', 'or', and parentheses for grouping."},{"order":8,"type":"code","text":"--- 
- name: Conditional with multiple checks
  hosts: all
  tasks:
    - name: Restart service on specific conditions
      service:
        name: nginx
        state: restarted
      when: 
        - ansible_os_family == "RedHat"
        - ansible_distribution_major_version == "8"
        - nginx_enabled | bool"},{"order":9,"type":"subheading","text":"Iterating Over Data with 'loop'"},{"order":10,"type":"paragraph","text":"The modern 'loop' keyword replaced older constructs like 'with_items' in Ansible 2.5+. It provides cleaner syntax and better integration with complex data structures. Within the task, the current item is referenced via the 'item' variable."},{"order":11,"type":"code","text":"--- 
- name: Create multiple system groups
  hosts: all
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Ensure required groups exist
      group:
        name: "{{ item }}"
        state: present
      loop:
        - devops
        - sysadmin
        - database"},{"order":12,"type":"subheading","text":"Legacy Iteration: 'with_items'"},{"order":13,"type":"paragraph","text":"You will frequently encounter 'with_items' in older playbooks and roles. While 'loop' is preferred for new code, 'with_items' functions similarly by iterating over a flat list."},{"order":14,"type":"code","text":"--- 
- name: Install legacy packages
  hosts: all
  tasks:
    - name: Install utilities using with_items
      apt:
        name: "{{ item }}"
        state: latest
      with_items:
        - curl
        - git
        - htop"},{"order":15,"type":"subheading","text":"Combining Loops and Conditionals"},{"order":16,"type":"paragraph","text":"When you apply a 'when' statement to a task that contains a 'loop', Ansible evaluates the conditional statement for *every single item* in the loop."},{"order":17,"type":"code","text":"--- 
- name: Conditional looping example
  hosts: all
  tasks:
    - name: Create user directories only if path is absolute
      file:
        path: "{{ item }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'
      loop:
        - "/var/app/logs"
        - "/var/app/data"
        - "relative/path/test"
      when: item.startswith('/')"},{"order":18,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Use 'when' for conditional execution based on facts or custom variables."},{"order":19,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Prefer 'loop' over legacy 'with_*' plugins for all new playbooks."},{"order":20,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Access loop elements inside tasks using the 'item' magic variable."}]
